title: The prose judge reads cites from every file a line names, not only changed files
why: Coordinator 23:18 CST Nov 13 (relayed; from lane merge-reads-newest-check-run, #3358 hand-in 23:17; merge.py read unverified): prose_judge_lines takes a line's cites from changed-file cites only, so a line citing one changed and one unchanged file can read "unbacked" though the unchanged cite backs it. A false alarm. The judge's verdicts also vary run to run.
